fusions.name: Edge From Behind
fusions.desc: A weapon strike from the blind side that deals 32 damage, always crits and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unannounced
fusions.desc: Throws a musk-wet sliver at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, it has 50% more crit chance.

fusions.name: There Before They Turn
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fair Warning Expired
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 50% more crit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
